name: Doctor Surlee
source:
Doctor Surlee is the Ultimate Scientist. He is a pragmatic and observant primate who assists in investigations with his scientific knowledge. 

[spoiler]Doctor Surlee is a clone of [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gyro_Gearloose]Gyro Gearloose[/url], who cloned himself and traveled back in time after accidentally creating the Cogs. He finds himself able to communicate with another Doctor Surlee clone who is outside of the killing game, and forms a plan with his clone and [url=/c145428]Headless Horsetoon[/url] to infiltrate and stop [url=/c145427]Flunky[/url]'s plan.[/spoiler]
